Here’s a **clean AI prompt** you can use to generate a login page visually identical in style to the image you uploaded — but with **no GitHub login button** (only Google + email/password).  

---

**🎨 Prompt for AI image/UI generator:**

> Design a sleek, modern login page UI with a dark theme and gradient background similar to emerald green or dark teal.  
> The layout should be split into two sections:
> - **Left side:** A smooth gradient panel with a welcoming title like “Welcome Back” and small subtitle text such as “Access your account to continue.”  
>   Include a 3-step progress indicator (for example: 1️⃣ Login, 2️⃣ Setup Workspace, 3️⃣ Setup Profile) with step one highlighted.  
> - **Right side:** A minimalist login form with rounded input fields and a white accent "Log In" button.  
>   Add **“Continue with Google”** button at the top, **no GitHub button**.  
>   Below that, include email and password input fields (with placeholder text examples).  
>   Below the button, add a small text link: “Don’t have an account? Sign up.”  
> 
> Use soft shadows, clean typography (like Inter or Poppins), and balanced white space.  
> Make it responsive and professional — startup-level design quality.

---

Would you like me to generate the **React + Tailwind login page code** for this design next? I can make it match the image’s layout and colors exactly.
